body.name: \widehat{\tau}^{*}_n(x_0)
body.construction:
\[
 \widehat\tau_n^*(x_0)=\operatorname{clip}_{[-2L,2L]}
 \left\{G_n\widehat\tau_n^G(x_0)+P_n\widehat\tau_n^P(x_0)\right\}.
\]
Each branch is everywhere defined by its own bounded fallback.  On \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{pair}}\), both handles instantiate \(\widehat\tau_n^{\mathrm{pair}}(x_0)\), while the deterministic exhaustive switch is retained.
